user.title: Sign in to OpenLuat
user.description:
Sign in with your OpenLuat (AirCloud) account. Username is the phone number.

**Captcha model** (optional): leave it on "do not solve automatically" and the next step shows the captcha image for you to type manually. Pick a model and the integration fetches the image, reads it and submits it for you; a wrong guess triggers a fresh image and a retry, up to 3 times, then it falls back to manual entry.

⚠️ **Pick a vision (multimodal) model** — a text-only model cannot read the image and every automatic attempt will fail (you can still type the code manually, sign-in is unaffected).

⚠️ The platform allows **one session only**: signing in here signs out the mobile app and any other web session.{detail}

📌 Your sign-in details (phone number, password, captcha model) are stored in the integration — the platform allows one session only, so when another sign-in kicks this integration off it **signs back in automatically**; normally no action is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to OpenLuat again
reauth_confirm.description:
The platform allows **one session only**: signing in from the mobile app or another browser invalidates this integration. Please sign in again.

The captcha model is optional — **pick a vision model**. Leave it on "do not solve automatically" to type the captcha manually in the next step.{detail}

init.description: Polling interval and device selection. The three fields below keep the **session alive automatically**: the platform allows one session only, so signing in from the mobile app or a browser immediately kicks this integration off. Fill in the phone number, password and pick a **vision model**, and the integration signs back in by itself (retrying every 10 minutes on failure) — normally no action is needed.
